description: This file implements the UserService interface, providing service methods related to User entities, such as findByEmail, saveUser, findAll, findBySupervisor, and calculating maximum contract value based on user roles.

classes.name: UserServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of UserService interface providing user-related business logic, including user lookup, saving, and role-based calculations.

methods.name: findByEmail
methods.description: Finds a User entity by email address.

methods.name: saveUser
methods.description: Encodes the user's password, activates the user, and saves it to the repository.

methods.name: findBySupervisor
methods.description: Finds users supervised by the given User.

methods.name: getMaxContractValue
methods.description: Calculates the maximum contract value from the roles associated with the user.
